results.title: Ten concurrent reads of a `max_reads: 1` share
results.evidence: a share capped at one read served 5 of ten simultaneous reads at worst across 5 rounds (served [1, 5, 5, 5, 5]). `open_share` reads `share['reads']` before the state check and writes `reads + 1` after serving, with no lock and no conditional update — racers that read the same count all pass the cap and all serve. `max_reads` is the control a firm relies on when a link has gone somewhere it should

results.title: Revoking a share that has already expired
results.evidence: an expired share can still be revoked, and the record keeps both the expiry and the revocation

results.title: Search `limit` at 0, 200, 201, and `abc`
results.evidence: 200 accepted; 0 and 201 refused 'limit_out_of_range'; 'abc' refused 'validation_error' — every 422 on this parameter carries a code, so one client path reads all three

results.title: Coverage driven to 1.0 by mislabelling one file
results.evidence: near-identical binary filed twice — as `application/pdf` and as `text/plain` — move coverage from 0.0 to 0.5, because `text_indexed` is `media_type in TEXT_MEDIA` and the media type is whatever the uploading client declared. The mislabelled copy is now counted as searchable and its bytes are searched as text (1 result(s) for a term inside it). Coverage is the figure a reader is told to check BEFOR
